summary: Master digital transformation in social protection administration. Learn ISSA guidelines, G2P payments, and social registry modernization. Enroll today.
lede: Digital Transformation in Social Protection Administration helps you replace fragmented, paper-based workflows with integrated, data-driven systems for more efficient, transparent, and inclusive service delivery. This practical course covers social registry modernization, Government-to-Person payment integration, biometric identity verification, automated eligibility screening, and cross-sectoral data exchange. You will develop beneficiary journey maps, data governance frameworks, and automated compliance approaches while exploring Integrated Social Information Systems, the Digital Social Protection maturity model, mobile money, and AI-powered analytics. The training also addresses legacy systems, staff digital-literacy gaps, budget constraints, interoperability, modular design, MOSIP® standards, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 principles for protecting sensitive beneficiary data.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and oversight of modern social assistance and insurance programs.
modules: AI and Data Analytics in Eligibility
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in social protection, social security, or public sector administration. Familiarity with basic information systems and social policy frameworks is recommended. No advanced programming skills are required, but a working knowledge of organizational workflows is essential.
